system.description:
Add-On (Passive): Add-Ons are made to an item with the Clothes Set property. They take no item slot: denote them on the Clothing Set to which they are added.

Sigil (Passive): This item identifies something about you: it can be your family sigil, your country, or your guild. When you purchase this item, denote what it signifies. At a glance, anyone can identify the sigil. You may add a maximum of 1 Sigil to any Clothing Set.

No Item Slot · 5gc · Clothing Add-Ons, rulebook p.199
